title: Legal Per-Se BAC Thresholds: Adult Operator (0.08% / 0.05% UT), Commercial CDL (0.04%), and Under-21 Zero Tolerance

no_head_on_same_lane.note: All vehicles ahead are viewed from behind in same direction; no oncoming vehicle facing viewer in same lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: Three interior views left side show left-hand-drive steering wheels held by driver on left; no right-side wheel.

single_bulb_signal.note: Three roadside signals each show only top red lens lit, other two lenses dark.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Left panels drive on right side of road with yellow center markings on left of lane and white edge/curb on right; no left-hand traffic.

zero_text.note: No letters, numbers, or words visible; plates, diamond and pedestrian signs are blank shapes with pictograms only.

scene_match.note: Shows 3-tier comparison: top sedan + gauge, middle semi-truck + gauge, bottom youth/permit + gauge with progressively lower threshold marks, matching prompt.

result.summary: All visual rules pass and 3-tier concept is present, but gauge levels do not clearly teach adult 0.08 > CDL 0.04 > under-21 zero, with middle gauge appearing equal/higher than top, requiring human review.

teaching_correct.note: Middle CDL gauge needle/red zone appears equal to or higher than top adult gauge, which could imply CDL allows equal/more alcohol opposite of 0.04 stricter rule; plus red lights beside moving highway traffic are confusing.

result.what_i_see: Three-row graphic: left shows driver POVs behind sedan, semi-truck, and at crosswalk; center shows circular gauges with red threshold marks; right shows white icons of sedan on red, semi on orange, graduate with card on green.
